svg.title: Cinema poster: remove a repeated admission badge
svg.desc: Only the circular FREE ENTRY badge is deleted. Free remains in the headline. Every retained word, size, position, photograph/crop, paper, palette and lighting is identical. The underlying photo is revealed, not regenerated.
svg.metadata: Original fictional Patternverse teaching example with shared generated photographic artwork. Only the circular FREE ENTRY badge is deleted. Free remains in the headline. Every retained word, size, position, photograph/crop, paper, palette and lighting is identical. The underlying photo is revealed, not regenerated.
